as_told.title: Dick Cheney as last head of the program

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says that David Grusch, a former intelligence official who went public with UFO claims, has said that Dick Cheney, the former US vice president who had just died, was head of the secret UFO programme. In a later episode Michels puts it as a question to the scientist Eric Davis, asking whether Cheney was the last person in charge of such a programme. If true, it would place one of the most powerful men in Washington at the centre of the secret.
